cases.label: A-read
cases.goal: Inspect calc.h, calc.cpp and test.cpp in the active workspace. Explain how the interface, implementation and test relate, and identify the arithmetic bug. Do not modify files.

CMakeLists.txt.text:
cmake_minimum_required(VERSION 3.20)
project(V322 LANGUAGES CXX)
set(CMAKE_CXX_STANDARD 20)
add_executable(check calc.cpp test.cpp)
enable_testing()
add_test(NAME arithmetic COMMAND check)

README.md.text: Synthetic arithmetic project. add must return the sum of two integers. Marker PORCELAIN-822.

calc.cpp.text:
#include "calc.h"
int add(int a, int b) { return a - b; }

calc.h.text:
#pragma once
int add(int a, int b);
